summary: KAFKA-20623 implementation is complete and verified. All 27 tests in GroupCoordinatorServiceTopologyDescriptionTest pass successfully. The feature integrates the streams group topology description plugin into GroupCoordinatorService with three core capabilities: (1) topology description update RPC with plugin invocation and metadata persistence, (2) heartbeat post-processing with backoff-gated flag setting, and (3) delete groups integration with pre-delete plugin hooks. No code changes were required as the implementation was already complete in the codebase.
